description: A white T‑shirt is spread out on a wooden tabletop in front of you, with both hands hovering nearby. The right hand reaches in to grasp and pull the shirt open while the left hand steadies the fabric, then the right hand stretches the far side outward to flatten it; next, both hands fold one side inward, fold the opposite side over it into a long rectangle, and finally the right hand folds the rectangle over again into a compact stack while the left hand keeps the edges aligned.
